summary: Retested JWT role protection and core API workflow; authorization passes, but the doctor UI crashes when no consultation is active.

minor.issue: Existing regression fixture still hard-codes 2026-03-04 11:00 AM and receives 409 because the slot is occupied.
Existing regression test expects exactly {ok:true}; the secured implementation correctly adds access_token and token_type.

ui_bugs.issue: Doctor route shows a runtime error when no patient is in consultation: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace'). Backend returns {} and the component treats it as truthy before reading active.token_number.

action_items: Fix DoctorBoard empty-state handling (use active?.id or change /api/active-consultation to return null, and render the no-patient notice without calling replace).
Update backend regression test to use an unused future date/slot and assert token response fields rather than exact verify JSON.
critical_code_review_comments: The frontend must not assume an object response contains token_number; API empty-object sentinels currently crash the entire doctor page.

success_rate.backend: 88% (14/14 targeted authorization/workflow checks; legacy suite 1/3 due stale assertions and occupied fixture)
success_rate.frontend: 75% (booking page, desk unlock, mobile overflow passed; doctor empty state failed; booking probe date had no slots)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST Iter4 follow-up appointment on 2026-10-14, verified payment, moved it to in_consultation, and saved a test prescription.
context_for_next_testing_agent: JWT staff/doctor tokens, no-auth 401, wrong-role 403, queue/status, active consultation, and prescription API checks all passed. Re-test Doctor route with no active consultation, then complete browser booking using an available weekday slot.
rca of the issue: GET /api/active-consultation returns {} when empty. In DoctorBoard, !active is false for {}, so rendering reaches active.token_number.replace(...), causing the observed runtime error and blank/error-overlay page.
